implementation.summary: D46 adds no production code. It binds the existing Streaming Studio route journey to an exact clean candidate and exercises invalid limits, poison input, oversized input, checkpoint non-advancement, partitioned bounded drain and explicit recovery against real services.

commands.cleanup_and_regenerate: candidate-boundary cleanup was run after the first candidate generation; the same source SHA regenerated identical archive and manifest hashes and final verify passed
commands.candidate_contracts: exact candidate sandbox: 135 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; the final regenerated sandbox was then verified clean
commands.candidate_quality: exact candidate sandbox: Node syntax checks passed; Ruff format/check and mypy passed on the streaming/control-plane selection
commands.local_gates: architecture gate, negative gates, route consistency for 200 operations, dependency surfaces, OpenAPI, capability status, daily ledger, public status and git diff check passed on main before the D46 receipt commit
commands.live_result: real PostgreSQL, Redpanda/Kafka and Ronin API; 1/1 Playwright case passed; the route exercised invalid, poison, oversized, recovery and two-partition paths; 52/52 API events correlated, 48 OK and 4 expected WARN, with zero unexpected server/network errors; services cleaned

qualification_matrix.route_streaming_journey: PASS for the filtered route: the real Studio route created and read stream definitions, replayed a valid stream, drained both explicit Kafka partitions in bounded batches and reached zero lag
qualification_matrix.invalid_limit: PASS candidate-bound live assertion: limit=0 returns HTTP 400 and does not claim a successful batch
qualification_matrix.poison_input: PASS candidate-bound live assertion: the corrupt JSON returns HTTP 422 stream_input_rejected twice, does not expose the invalid payload and leaves lag at 1
qualification_matrix.oversized_input: PASS candidate-bound live assertion: the oversized record returns HTTP 422 stream_input_rejected without leaking the payload, leaves lag at 1, then a reset to a valid source consumes one record and reaches lag zero
qualification_matrix.partitioned_drain: PASS candidate-bound live assertion: the real two-partition fixture drains twelve records in six bounded batches and verifies per-partition lag reaches zero
qualification_matrix.traffic_audit: PASS for the filtered diagnostic: 52/52 API events correlated to structured HTTP logs, 48 OK and 4 expected WARN, zero uncorrelated events, zero unexpected authorization gaps and zero server/network errors
qualification_matrix.candidate_reproducibility_after_cleanup: PASS; archive SHA 206bd165354ea9005062bb9ad3e9e17fb1e1b45edccaf9234078b25c47273145 and manifest SHA 5039a200881a46c6352bcf530a63bbbbee833e050028512b785dd7b84222730 were unchanged after cleanup/regeneration and final verify passed
qualification_matrix.security_scans: NOT_RERUN in D46; prior Gitleaks and pip-audit evidence remains separate and is not copied as a new D46 PASS
qualification_matrix.license_qualification: INHERITED FAIL/CLOSED; 21 human review decisions remain missing
qualification_matrix.result: D46 passes the filtered streaming negative/recovery campaign cell, but does not qualify P11, close a release gate or change NO-GO

security_and_recovery.journey: The exact live journey used real PostgreSQL, Redpanda/Kafka and Ronin API services, exercised valid replay, invalid bounds, poison retry, oversized rejection, valid-source recovery and a two-partition bounded drain, then cleaned all services.
security_and_recovery.negative_paths: Traffic records one expected invalid_request 400, two expected stream_input_rejected 422 poison responses and one expected stream_input_rejected 422 oversized response; browser assertions verify authorization remains present, checkpoint lag is unchanged on rejection and the recovery path commits only the valid record.
security_and_recovery.recovery_scope: This campaign proves the route-level poison/oversized recovery and bounded two-partition path. It does not prove sustained indefinite backpressure, multi-broker quorum recovery, worker supervision, external provider breadth or the complete P11 journey.

open_cells: P11 remains in_progress: D46 strengthens the route-level negative and recovery slice, while sustained backpressure, worker supervision, broader provider breadth and the complete family journey remain open.
P2 and P14 remain in_progress; D46 does not add connector/provider or external recovery qualification.
P13 remains blocked by external secret-provider qualification and release evidence; no authorized external secret provider or credential was available.
D46 does not rerun the full Python suite, Gitleaks, pip-audit or Trivy; skipped and inherited lanes are not counted as PASS.
No release gate is closed; release remains NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.
limitations: The live runner was a filtered route diagnostic: route-wide coverage was not audited even though the application has 25 active routes and 24 API-backed routes.

D46 adds no production code and proves one local route journey only; it does not prove indefinite load, multi-broker quorum recovery, worker supervision, external providers or the full P11 family journey.
No hosted workflow, branch or worktree was used; license review remains FAIL/CLOSED with 21 human decisions pending.
